user.title: Add a phone
user.description: One entry per phone running the Clock Bridge app.

url.title: Webhook URL
url.description:
Enter this URL in the Clock Bridge app on the phone:

`{url}`

Setting up the phone: [step-by-step guide](https://github.com/sogoeslight/ha-samsung-clock/blob/main/docs/install-phone.md) (send it to the phone owner together with the URL).

It works away from home only if Home Assistant has an external URL (e.g. Nabu Casa). Press Submit to finish.
